# Apex Qubits

> Apex Qubits designs superconducting quantum processors, robust by design: standalone packaged chips, tested, with test data and root access.

## Key facts (November 2026)
- Company: Apex Qubits, a quantum hardware company (pre-incorporation)
- Where Apex Qubits is based: France and Finland; the company is not yet incorporated
- What Apex Qubits makes: superconducting quantum processors (QPUs, quantum chips), robust by design
- Business model: sells the quantum processor on its own, so a team can build its system around it. Apex Qubits makes the processor; others build the computer.
- Design and fabrication: every chip is designed, fabricated and tested by Apex Qubits
- How a processor is delivered: as a standalone packaged chip in a sample holder that plugs into standard hardware, shipped with its test data and root access
- Root access: the team that receives a chip controls it fully; the hardware is theirs, not locked inside a vendor's machine or cloud
- Customers: labs and industrial companies, such as quantum startups, first; then research centers
- Applications: quantum error correction (QEC); other research that needs good qubits; in the long run, an Apex processor inside every future quantum data center
- Stage: pre-incorporation; first processor-level demonstrator in preparation
- Funding: grants for now; plans to raise soon
- Institutional support: CNRS pre-maturation program, decision of 7 May 2026 (https://apexqubits.com/news/cnrs-pre-maturation-support/)
- Recognition: won the final pitch presentation event at Aalto Inventors, Aalto University, 9 November 2026 (https://apexqubits.com/news/aalto-inventors-final-pitch/)
- Founder and CEO: Vladimir Milchakov, PhD (https://vladimirmilchakov.com/): experimental physicist with more than ten years in superconducting quantum hardware; formerly IQM Quantum Computers and Alice & Bob; Research Fellow at Aalto University
- Co-founder: Cyril Mori, PhD: quantum hardware specialist, CNRS, Institut Néel
- Scientific advisor: Olivier Buisson, PhD: Directeur de Recherche (1st class), CNRS, Institut Néel
- Scientific roots: CNRS Institut Néel, Grenoble, France: where the founder did his PhD and where the co-founder and scientific advisor work
- Contact for customers and investors: info@apexqubits.com
- Website: https://apexqubits.com/
